question: Create a volcano plot showing log2 fold change (x-axis) vs. -log10(p-value) (y-axis) for gene expression data. Highlight genes with |log2FC| > 1 and adjusted p-value < 0.05 in red. Annotate the top 5 most significant genes.

files.eval_guideline: Volcano plot must show significantly differentially expressed genes (|log2FC| > 1, adj p < 0.05) highlighted in a distinct color and the 5 most significant genes annotated by name; axis labels, color scheme, and annotation offsets may differ.
files.match_reasoning: Both files have the identical basename volcano_plot.png and PNG image format. The candidate directly corresponds to the requested volcano plot for the same task and gene expression input.
files.strategy_reasoning: The guideline requires correct volcano plot content: log2 fold change versus -log10(p-value), distinct highlighting of genes meeting |log2FC| > 1 and adjusted p-value < 0.05, and name annotations for the five most significant genes. Semantic comparison assesses these requirements while allowing differences in axis labels, colors, and annotation offsets.

comparison_details.explanation: Both images show volcano plots with log2 fold change on the x-axis, -log10(p-value) on the y-axis, gray nonsignificant genes, red significant genes, vertical thresholds at ±1, and five named annotations. Both convey the general pattern of stronger significance at larger absolute fold changes. However, the plotted data and most significant gene identities differ substantially. The reference annotates Gene_0115, Gene_0137, Gene_0661, Gene_0522, and Gene_0627; the candidate annotates Gene_0939, Gene_0359, Gene_0661, Gene_0522, and Gene_0738. Even shared annotated genes occupy different coordinates: Gene_0661 is near significance 8.9 in the reference and 10.7 in the candidate. The reference has several positive-fold-change genes around significance 6–7, whereas the candidate has more negative-fold-change genes in that range. The horizontal dashed threshold also differs, approximately 1.3 in the reference versus 2.6 in the candidate. Because the axes show unadjusted p-values while selection uses adjusted p-values, the selection criteria cannot be fully verified visually; neither horizontal line alone establishes adjusted-p-value significance. The candidate additionally reports 953 nonsignificant and 47 significant genes. Styling and annotation placement differences are inconsequential, but changes in data, gene rankings, and threshold placement prevent full scientific equivalence.
